author: sudekistheboss
body: MonsieurGray is the best mod ever. He truly is such an amazing awesome person. I wanted to make this post to wish him a merry christmas and show that we avicus players appreciate his work. If you agree with me that MonsieurGray is an amazing person, leave a comment on this post so that he knows he is loved by our community.
